categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Labeled P2P and modifies connection management logic in src/net.cpp and src/net.h.
categories.rationale: Prevents redundant outbound manual connections caused by concurrent connection attempts racing before peers are registered in m_nodes. As noted in the description, overlapping -connect/-addnode startup options or concurrent addnode onetry calls could race past duplicate checks and establish multiple connections to the same peer.
